items.title: Novo's CagriSema Outshines Zepbound in Key Phase III Weight-Loss Study
items.summary: NVO's CagriSema delivers greater weight loss than Eli Lilly's tirzepatide in T2D and 21% weight loss in obesity, strengthening its late-stage pipeline.

items.title: Eli Lilly Breaks Ground on $6.5B Generation Park Facility
items.summary: A $6.5B Eli Lilly biomanufacturing facility broke ground at Houston’s Generation Park, Texas’ largest pharmaceutical investment to date.

items.title: An orexin drug’s ‘proof-of-concept’ in ADHD; Cue’s ‘unwarranted’ share slide
items.summary: Alkermes’ results heightened anticipation for a coming readout in 2027. Elsewhere, AbbVie leaned into AI drug discovery and the FDA expanded use of Eli Lilly’s breast cancer pill.

items.title: His Bet On Home Depot Made Ken Langone A Billionaire. Now He Sees Eli Lilly Stock Hitting $2,000
items.summary: Ken Langone built a fortune betting on Home Depot decades before anyone called it a sure thing, and now he says another stock in his portfolio is giving it a serious run for the top spot.

items.title: Could You Have Seen Merck Stock's Pipeline Run Coming?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock gained about 89% in the year from mid-September 2025, against a 17.1% price gain for the S&P 500. It also beat Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), up 58%, and Eli Lilly (LLY), up 54%. The signs were public long before the run, in what management kept saying about its drug pipeline. The reported sales told a different story.

items.title: Viking Therapeutics Skyrockets On Obesity Drug Data. Eli Lilly, Novo Fall.
items.summary: Viking stock catapulted Tuesday on "stellar" test results for its weight-loss shot, sending shares of rivals Eli Lilly and Novo lower.

items.title: Viking Therapeutics Stock Surges 30%. It Could Challenge Lilly and Novo’s Obesity Empire.
items.summary: Viking Therapeutics and Roche are developing drugs for obesity and diabetes to challenge Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk’s market duopoly.

items.title: Roche Obesity Drug Enicepatide Delivers 15.5% Weight Loss in Phase 2 Diabetes Trial
items.summary: Roche (USOTC:RHHBY) has reported positive results from a mid-stage clinical trial of its experimental obesity treatment enicepatide, with patients who have type 2 diabetes achieving average weight loss of 15. 5% alongside improvements in blood sugar control.
